description: Keyboard focus applies the same parabolic zoom as the mouse, but the text tooltip does not appear even after a long wait.

assertions.comment: On keyboard entry, the first icon zooms smoothly from 1.0 to the default MaxZoomFactor of 1.6.
Parabolic falloff reduces neighbor icon scales with distance from the keyboard focus center.
After moving with Right, the zoom center also moves to the second icon at scale 1.6.
The unnamed tooltip Rectangle QML child-index path depends on the structure, but show remains false in keyboard mode.
The text tooltip background does not appear even when keyboard focus is held for a long time.
